# Savi Saluwadana

Canonical portfolio: https://savisaluwadana.github.io/
Canonical agent-readable profile: https://savisaluwadana.github.io/llms.txt

Savi Saluwadana is a software, platform, DevOps and AI systems engineer based in Sri Lanka. His portfolio focuses on Go, Kubernetes, CI/CD, developer platforms, PostgreSQL, MCP, operational reliability and end-to-end product engineering.

Selected work includes DevRelOS, Property Management OS, RapidReach, Avara Real Estate, Blu.lk and FreshPick / FreshOnTime.
